title: Part-Time Job Finder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Locates work opportunities compatible with class schedules. The Part-Time Job Finder locates work opportunities compatible with classes. It searches job listings filtered by the student's availability, location, and skills — campus jobs, retail, tutoring, gigs — and ranks by pay, hours fit, and commute. Each listing shows the schedule honestly so the student never takes a job that breaks their classes.
capabilities: Search listings by availability and skills
Rank by pay, hours fit, and commute
Cover campus jobs, retail, tutoring, gigs
Show real schedules before applying
Flag jobs that conflict with classes
